sections.Profile:
"Out Law" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Hanilamatic in 1986. The game features an adventure theme, with backglass artwork depicting actors Bo Svenson and Mark Gregory from either the 1983 movie "Thunder" or the 1987 movie "Thunder II".

- Manufacturer: ManilaMatic
- Years made: 1986
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Original Theme, Solid State, Action, Adventure, 1980s
sections.Editions: - Out Law: released 1986-01-01, ManilaMatic System 80B Combi
